rubriker.title: Fide Bans Minor For 2 Years After Phone With Chess Com Open Found Hidden In Shoe
Minor Chess Player Receives Two-Year Ban for Cheating
rubriker._rss_content: A minor chess player has been banned for two years after being caught with a hidden phone during a tournament in Slovenia.

rubriker.title: Salesforce FIDE World Championship Match 2026
rubriker._rss_content: FIDE is pleased to announce the regulations for the Salesforce FIDE World Championship Match 2026, confirming the venue, format, schedule, and prize distribution for the meeting between reigning World Champion Grandmaster Gukesh D and his challenger, Grandmaster Javokhir Sindarov. The match will be held at the Fondation Martin Bodmer in Cologny, Geneva, Switzerland, from 22 November to 13 December 2026, bringing a World Championship match back to Switzerland for the first time since Brissago in 2004.

rubriker.title: Samarkand ready for a record-breaking Chess Olympiad
rubriker._rss_content: For centuries, Samarkand stood at the crossroads of civilisations. Merchants, scholars and travellers crossed the ancient Silk Road, carrying ideas and cultures from one part of the world to another. Now, another kind of journey will bring the world to the legendary city: 400 chess teams from across the globe will gather for the 46th FIDE Chess Olympiad.

Europamesterskapet for døve starter
rubriker._rss_content: I dag starter Europamesterskapet i sjakk for døve i Stavanger. Arrangør er Døves sjakkforening. Mesterskapet har to grupper, for lag og individuelt. Begge spiller syv runder fra 15. til 18. september 2026. Betenkningstid er 90 minutter med 30 sekunder tillegg pr. trekk. Lagmesterskapet har 10 lag påmeldt og spilles over 4 bord. rubriker.title: Romania's Chess Federation Formally Endorses Rosenstein for FIDE President
rubriker._rss_content: The Romanian Chess Federation has thrown its official backing behind Wadim Rosenstein's FIDE presidential ticket, in a signed statement of support dated September 15 from Bucharest, published by Rosenstein on X with a simple "Thank you, Romania."

rubriker.title: Tickets Now Available for 46th FIDE Chess Olympiad in Samarkand
rubriker._rss_content: Spectator tickets for the 46th FIDE Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, are now on sale, with various ticket categories available.
